earthLost: Nibiru destroyed Earth on 21 December 2012. There is no world map: going outside takes you to the Omega Tower.

populationNotes.chaos: Random encounters, NPCs, shop stock and prices. Level ups teach random skills.
populationNotes.goblin: Everyone is a goblin, your characters too. Goblins are the most common creature.
populationNotes.monster: No humans, elves or goblins anywhere. Every other archetype appears.
populationNotes.empty: Nobody is left: no shopkeepers, news, plagues, law or work. History stops on 1 January 2000 and property is worthless.
populationNotes.zombie: Nine in ten people are replaced by undead.
populationNotes.death: An empty world with no creatures at all: no monsters, beasts or dungeon foes.

magicalNotes.severed: No spells, enchanted items or magical creatures. No MP bar. The party keeps only what it starts with.
magicalNotes.unbound: Weapons are enchanted, illnesses are curses and creatures mutate. No ordinary gear in shops or loot.

magicalLocked: Can't be changed after creation. Works with any timeline.

worldRegenerated: The default world has been restored.
